name: Amarjeet Sohi
profileSummary: Amarjeet Sohi is a Canadian politician who was the minister of infrastructure and communities, and from 2018 to 2019 as the minister of natural resources. Sohi previously sat as a Liberal member of Parliament (MP) and served in the federal Cabinet from 2015 to 2018. He served as the 36th mayor of Edmonton from 2021 to 2025.
